page.overview:
Who is Hardtop?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Hardtop was available in 1987, packaged with the Defiant shuttle as the Crawler driver. ---- Appearance: white hardhat; blue shirt with white backpack straps with red trim; blue pants with white belt, holster, pad

Accessories: white bent mic attaching to helmet; black pistol with diagonal grooves on side.

Variations: some versions of Hardtop did not come with the black handgun. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/87/hardtop.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/87/hardtop.shtml Filecard]
